chart.description: Saturation of the gateway hosts (max of CPU, memory and disk utilization)
chart.name: Gateway saturation
chart.programText:
A = data('cpu.utilization', filter=filter('source', 'gateway')).sum(by=['host','cluster']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('system.cpu.time', filter=filter('source', 'gateway') and (not filter('state', 'idle'))).sum(by=['host','cluster']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('system.cpu.time', filter=filter('source', 'gateway')).sum(by=['host','cluster']).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = ((B/C)*100).publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = union(A, D).publish(label="E", enable=False)
F = data('system.memory.usage', filter=filter('source', 'gateway') and filter('state', 'used')).sum(by=['host','cluster']).publish(label='F', enable=False)
G = data('system.memory.usage', filter=filter('source', 'gateway') and filter('state', 'used', 'free', 'buffered', 'cached')).sum(by=['host','cluster']).publish(label='G', enable=False)
H = ((F/G)*100).publish(label='H', enable=False)
I = data('system.filesystem.usage', filter=filter('source', 'gateway') and filter('state', 'free', 'used')).sum(by=['host','cluster']).publish(label='I', enable=False)
J = data('system.filesystem.usage',filter=filter('source', 'gateway') and filter('state', 'used')).sum(by=['host','cluster']).publish(label='J', enable=False)
K = ((I/J)*100).publish(label='K', enable=False)
L = max(E, H, K).sum(by=['host','cluster']).publish(label='L')
